title: Felix and the Autopsy
author: Juniper Brightwater
blurb: Lior Reyes, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
